selection_rule: evaluate every frozen prompt/seed cell once; rank candidates on development seeds by quality-pass count, then correction RMS, then shorter horizon; report the selected candidate only if all preregistered development, holdout, overall, and preservation floors pass

correction.linear_channels: root xyz and all 29 G1 joint angles
correction.linear_boundary_condition: position and first-difference residual at the second-chunk start decay to zero with a quintic Hermite envelope
correction.root_orientation: left-multiplicative start-pose quaternion residual decays to identity with the same position envelope
